sources.name: horizon-rust/horizon — repository
sources.why: Native Rust/wgpu renderer, benchmark and differential-testing approach.
sources.caveat: Different voxel workloads; do not transfer FPS claims to Fessa.

sources.name: Horizon performance methodology
sources.why: Worker split, vertex arena, indirect multi-draw and explicit FPS/1% low baselines.
sources.caveat: Their internal gains are not relative to vanilla.

sources.name: Horizon graphics settings and performance
sources.why: Performance budgets, shadow cache, foliage cutout mip dither, far LOD, debug metrics and GPU timing.
sources.caveat: Several shadow-cache paths are shader-pack-related, not drop-in Fessa CSM caching.

sources.name: Horizon flattened indirect terrain draws
sources.why: Compute compacts visible per-section indices into arena-page runs; one draw per run when multi-draw unavailable.
sources.caveat: Flat voxel quads; Fessa CBT indexed geometry needs separate geometry/identity invariants.

sources.name: Horizon mipmap alpha-coverage preservation
sources.why: Cutout mips preserve alpha-test coverage instead of thinning leaf/flower silhouettes at distance.
sources.caveat: Fessa currently uses opaque generated pinnules; apply only to actual MASK inputs, not blindly to geometry.

sources.name: Horizon renderer graphics policy
sources.why: Explicit advanced graphics capability tiers and optional upload/refresh limits, with HDR startup rollback marker.
sources.caveat: Do not interpret user-set quality budgets as equal-work speedup.

sources.name: Horizon terrain WGSL
sources.why: WGSL light/fog/terrain uniforms and cutout paths under wgpu.
sources.caveat: Vanilla-compatible lighting is not a physical atmospheric model.

sources.name: Horizon shader API design
sources.why: Stable WGSL renderer-stage hooks; documentation distinguishes shipped renderer from planned shader API.
sources.caveat: Shader API is a design, not necessarily deployed.

sources.name: Horizon post/pack graph
sources.why: Ping-pong render targets, depth layers, and explicit resource staging/ownership.
sources.caveat: Shader-pack integration specifics may change; no rationale to replicate it wholesale.

sources.name: Horizon reproducible benchmark
sources.why: Includes where vanilla is faster; methodology holds path, settings and devices explicit.
sources.caveat: Avoid projected estimates as physical measurements.

sources.name: Horizon graphics profiling notes
sources.why: Separates profiler sampling and actual timing; helps design clean before/after controls.
sources.caveat: JFR section primarily for Java comparison.

sources.name: Horizon roadmap
sources.why: Current/frame-pacing/worker scheduling tradeoffs and known open problems.
sources.caveat: Proposals are not verified implementations.

sources.name: Adventures with Deferred Texturing in Horizon Forbidden West
sources.why: Foliage/alpha-tested visibility prepass, loose tiling, compute material shading, software VRS.
sources.caveat: Algorithmic architecture only: proprietary Decima code not distributed on page.

sources.name: SIGGRAPH 2022 Decima real-time live
sources.why: System-level composition of a large outdoor environment under hard performance budgets.
sources.caveat: Showcase; not numeric proof of Fessa gains.

sources.name: Nubis 2015 — Real-time Volumetric Cloudscapes
sources.why: Cloud profiles, ray-march budgets, directional light scattering under PS4 target.
sources.caveat: 2015-era method; Fessa already has clouds; audit integration, not replacement.

sources.name: Nubis 2017 — authoring in Decima
sources.why: Weather map, shape layers, authoring, improved lighting/time-of-day.
sources.caveat: Opaque proprietary engine; abstract algorithms only.

sources.name: Nubis Evolved 2022
sources.why: Cloud flythrough and speed-sensitive rendering without relying on temporal upscale.
sources.caveat: Higher cost for full 3D immersive clouds; prioritize B03 ground sky first.

sources.name: Nubis cubed 2023
sources.why: Compressed SDF skipping, voxel detail upscaling, lighting acceleration, dark-edge/inner-glow.
sources.caveat: Voxel-cloud pipeline is not a direct replacement of existing 2.5D cloud field.

sources.name: Rendering Water in Horizon Forbidden West
sources.why: Localized deformations and breaking waves; references physically and artistically complex water.
sources.caveat: Primarily breaking ocean waves, not shallow static puddles.

sources.name: Nubis-like Vulkan implementation: Meteoros
sources.why: Readable procedural clouds, reprojection, and raymarch cost breakdown.
sources.caveat: Student implementation; do not copy its FPS claim to 880M.

sources.name: Ghost of Tsushima — Procedural Grass
sources.why: GPU per-blade generation, culling and indirect instance counts for lush grass.
sources.caveat: Authored production solution; do not alter Fessa authoritative scatter IDs.

sources.name: Ghost of Tsushima — Wind simulation
sources.why: Multi-scale shared wind, gust coherence across plants/particles; inexpensive dynamics.
sources.caveat: Add only if motion becomes an explicit visual goal.

sources.name: Ghost of Tsushima — visual effects
sources.why: Natural field coherence, foliage response and wind interactions at landscape scale.
sources.caveat: Primarily artistic/engine design, not a scientific lighting oracle.

sources.name: Far Cry 6 — Simulating Tropical Weather
sources.why: Wetness/puddles, sunlight, fog, volumetric clouds, wind and day-night consistency in one environment.
sources.caveat: No license to copy closed engine code; use conceptual checks.

sources.name: Hillaire — A Scalable and Production Ready Sky and Atmosphere Rendering Technique
sources.why: Ground-to-space transport, transmittance, multiple scattering, sky-view/aerial perspective LUTs.
sources.caveat: Avoid replacing existing atmosphere owner; compare numerical invariants first.

sources.name: Bruneton — Precomputed Atmospheric Scattering documentation
sources.why: Strong reference for radiance/transmittance formulae, unit safety, planet-generalized functions, regression tests.
sources.caveat: LUT parameterizations differ from Fessa; formula reference not direct architecture mandate.

sources.name: Bruneton — reference implementation
sources.why: GLSL/CPU reference oracles for TOA → surface RGB and long paths.
sources.caveat: BSD notice required if source copied; graphics simulation models may differ.

sources.name: Fewes MinimalAtmosphere
sources.why: Small readable Rayleigh/Mie/ozone example; object shader attenuates directional sunlight.
sources.caveat: Unoptimized education code only, not production reference timing.

sources.name: Hillaire implementation in OpenGL
sources.why: Code-level approximation and high-level comparison with Bruneton; verify upstream licensing.
sources.caveat: Third-party port, check exact license and provenance before reuse.

sources.name: Gigi Hillaire pipeline implementation
sources.why: Explicit transmittance, multiple scattering, sky-view and aerial-perspective passes.
sources.caveat: Different renderer bindings and resolution budgets.

sources.name: PBRT 4 — volume transmittance
sources.why: Correct segment transmittance laws; source visibility and medium attenuation separate.
sources.caveat: Physically rigorous reference but not a 1:1 real-time algorithm.

sources.name: PBRT 4 — volume scattering
sources.why: Separates scattering, absorption, phase function, volume path transmittance.
sources.caveat: Heavy Monte Carlo is oracle, not 880M primary solution.

sources.name: Unity HDRP clouds and fog architecture
sources.why: Cloud/sky integration, Beer shadow maps, environment lighting, fog and surface shading contracts.
sources.caveat: HDRP graphics package licensing must be checked per component before copying.

sources.name: Unity HDRP volumetric clouds implementation entry
sources.why: Shadow and fog interactions; verify current cloud vs ground coupling.
sources.caveat: Component docs, not matching physical data.

sources.name: Unity HDRP custom cloud effects
sources.why: Separate cloud transport policy from host pipeline, reusing the same sky light.
sources.caveat: Implementation detail may require Unity-specific pipeline.

sources.name: Godot rendering architecture
sources.why: Froxel volumetric fog and concrete Godot engine source paths for shaders and C++.
sources.caveat: Godot passes are not Fessa planetary medium.

sources.name: Kirme — Volumetric Clouds
sources.why: Adaptive raymarch and temporal cloud budgets; HLSL-to-WGSL conceptual comparison.
sources.caveat: Unity HLSL graduate demo; not benchmark-equivalent.

sources.name: AMD FidelityFX Hybrid Shadows
sources.why: Shadow-map visibility classification, reject lit/dark, ray interval reduction, denoising.
sources.caveat: Port GLSL/HLSL policy to WGSL; hardware capability and tile overhead vary.

sources.name: AMD Hybrid Shadows open sample
sources.why: Concrete classifier passes, ray-tracing integration, debug tiles.
sources.caveat: Original sample targets DXR; more recent SDK notes Vulkan support.

sources.name: AMD FidelityFX Shadow Classifier 1.3
sources.why: 8×4 tile ray masks, classification input/interval contracts.
sources.caveat: Fessa current gate does NOT implement tile classification.

sources.name: Unreal Virtual Shadow Maps & static/dynamic caching
sources.why: Page invalidation, separate cached static vs dynamic depth and correct debug views.
sources.caveat: Do not rewrite Fessa as full UE VSM; first split static caster depth for current cascades.

sources.name: Unreal Nanite foliage / aggregate geometry
sources.why: Thin/disjoint foliage breaks occlusion and area preservation; warns on overdraw.
sources.caveat: Preserve Area is only idea to test, no blanket silhouette inflation.

sources.name: Meshoptimizer — official library
sources.why: Meshlets, simplification with coverage-area concerns; potential per-shadow LOD or hierarchical cluster admission.
sources.caveat: Need validate Fessa area, topology and silhouette error, not triangles-only.

sources.name: Meshoptimizer foliage border dilation
sources.why: Cluster border dilation explicitly addresses foliage projected-area loss.
sources.caveat: This mutates positions; clone in tests and prove budget/area error.

sources.name: Meshoptimizer release and coverage analysis
sources.why: Coverage analysis, clusterlod updates, and disjoint-component handling.
sources.caveat: Experimental library APIs change, pin source versions.

sources.name: Hashed Alpha Testing (Wyman/McGuire)
sources.why: Stable probabilistic alpha coverage for distant MASK, shadow casters and foliage.
sources.caveat: Opaque geometric pinnules not alpha cards; use only in MASK path.

sources.name: Improved Alpha Testing Using Hashed Sampling
sources.why: Analysis of filtered alpha, alpha-to-coverage and temporal stability.
sources.caveat: Does not fix real geometric thin-triangle raster coverage.

sources.name: Horizon Rust cutout mips
sources.why: Practical coverage-preserving mip generation for alpha-tested foliage.
sources.caveat: Not a substitute for shadow/RT alpha semantics.

sources.name: Sascha Willems Vulkan indirect drawing
sources.why: Example literally batches different foliage/tree meshes into indirect draw calls.
sources.caveat: CPU/GPU submission bottleneck only; does not reduce pixel or triangle cost.

sources.name: Ghost grass GPU generation and clumping
sources.why: Decouple spatial clump field from random per-blade variation to avoid synthetic uniformity.
sources.caveat: Changing scatter is a content change, not render-only A/B.

sources.name: AMD FidelityFX SSSR sample docs
sources.why: Hi-Z traversal, roughness and variance-driven ray budget, disocclusion, denoising.
sources.caveat: Screen space misses offscreen/occluded; fallback cannot be assumed correct.

sources.name: AMD FidelityFX SSSR source
sources.why: Operational hierarchical depth traversal, ray compaction and denoising.
sources.caveat: Need actual depth, normals, roughness and history: not yet available to Fessa path.

sources.name: AMD FidelityFX SSSR technique
sources.why: Variance-guided rays per quad and roughness cutoff/fallback semantics.
sources.caveat: Port data contract rather than copy entire framework.

sources.name: Filament physically based shading
sources.why: GGX, energy preservation, IBL, F0, roughness, and specular aliasing.
sources.caveat: Avoid replacing verified existing Fessa direct GGX kernel.

sources.name: Filament material system
sources.why: Material layering masks, normals and physically meaningful wet/dry blends.
sources.caveat: Wet soil and puddles are distinct layers; no roughness-as-water classifier.

sources.name: Toksvig — Mipmapping Normal Maps
sources.why: Normal variance and mipmap anti-aliasing for sparkling ground and leaves.
sources.caveat: Fessa has roughness filtering; compare before adding redundant technique.

sources.name: Water in Horizon Forbidden West
sources.why: Breaking wave/rendering material features and localized surface deformation.
sources.caveat: Mostly sea-wave feature scope; not first priority for B03 puddles.

sources.name: Unity HDRP water and volumetric clouds
sources.why: Wetness, water, caustics, reflections and environmental response in one quality policy.
sources.caveat: No immediate need for a new ocean simulation.

sources.name: Ocean Simulation JONSWAP/TMA
sources.why: JONSWAP/TMA, IFFT, near-shore rendering and water shader optics.
sources.caveat: Ocean waves only after B03 shallow water optical acceptance.

sources.name: WGSL WebGPU FFT ocean
sources.why: Read WGSL GPU FFT stages, slopes, water normals, reflective sampling.
sources.caveat: Student project; may not reproduce wave physics of Fessa.

sources.name: Abyssal ocean spectral sample
sources.why: Layered spectrum, physical-looking twilight, sky-water shared illumination, Jacobian foam.
sources.caveat: Different JS/WebGL renderer and custom authored optics.

sources.name: Kajiya (Embark Studios) — Rust/Vulkan hybrid GI
sources.why: Render graph with raster+compute+RT, temporal reprojection, simple physically based path-traced ground truth.
sources.caveat: Experimental renderer with unsafe budgets and insufficient resource lifetime rigor.

sources.name: Kajiya — GI overview
sources.why: Irradiance cache + raytraced final gather and path-traced oracle.
sources.caveat: RTX/6800XT hardware results not transferable to 880M.

sources.name: NVIDIA RTXPT reference path tracer
sources.why: Compare hybrid raster path to explicit path-traced oracle; material/opacity/visibility semantics.
sources.caveat: RTX-specific denoisers/features; do not make a required runtime dependency.

sources.name: NVIDIA RTXDI / ReSTIR
sources.why: Spatial/temporal reuse of expensive light samples and visibility.
sources.caveat: Likely overkill for 3 stellar source slots; study only for many emissive sources.

sources.name: RTXDI algorithm integration reference
sources.why: Separation of light candidate sampling and geometry-dependent visibility.
sources.caveat: Not a magic replacement for deterministic shadow-map data.

sources.name: Rust GPU current organization
sources.why: Future Rust-to-SPIR-V experimentation if architecture merits it.
sources.caveat: Existing Fessa WGSL is valid; do not mandate a shader-language rewrite.

sources.name: Mesa: Debugging GPU hangs with RADV
sources.why: Obtain SPIR-V/trace/command markers and distinguish hang from GPU workload.
sources.caveat: Do NOT use recovery-disabled instructions on working desktop; no sysfs permission relaxation.

sources.name: Mesa general GPU crash debugging
sources.why: Captures, devcoredumps, reproduction safety and root-cause discipline.
sources.caveat: First use CPU admission and isolated GPU, never crash user Niri.

sources.name: AMD RDNA performance guide
sources.why: Wave occupancy, ALU/memory/front-end bottleneck, async scheduling considerations.
sources.caveat: Architecture generations and power budgets matter, measure 880M.

sources.name: Radeon GPU Profiler
sources.why: Pipeline timing, cache stalls, wavefront and barrier diagnostics.
sources.caveat: Official Linux support lists Ubuntu 24.04, Arch compatibility not assumed; safety gates apply.

sources.name: RGP manual
sources.why: GPU queue timeline separate from CPU encode/fence timing.
sources.caveat: Tool availability and RADV driver configuration must be checked.

sources.name: AMD concurrent async queues
sources.why: Shadows/depth and compute overlap only if actual complementary bottleneck.
sources.caveat: Async compute may REGRESS frame time due to cache thrash and barriers.

sources.name: Vulkan foliage indirect sample
sources.why: Reduce command overhead of repeated botanical prototypes.
sources.caveat: Only compare at same submitted geometry and shadow coverage.

sources.name: AMD GPU tools index
sources.why: Find profiler/visualizer/support, confirm OS/version before use.
sources.caveat: Radeon GPU Detective release is Windows-focused, do not prescribe it on Arch.

sources.name: Horizon performance methodology
sources.why: Frame pacing, main-thread competition, streaming vs GPU rendering split.
sources.caveat: Cross-game fps not comparable.

sources.name: Fessa baseline handoff audit source
sources.why: Audit existing ownership and tests before any port.
sources.caveat: Observed SHA 566cc6f; require agent to recheck HEAD.

sources.name: Existing FastRT primary receivers specification
sources.why: Single TLAS, default-off, correct raster fallback, current cost failures.
sources.caveat: Does not yet implement confidence or sparse tiles.

sources.name: Existing renderer roadmap
sources.why: Sequence C01/P04/S01 and existing test contracts.
sources.caveat: Do not overwrite roadmap evidence with untested design.

sources.name: Existing native scene/nozzle integration
sources.why: B03 reference scenario, 207M shadow triangle rejection, available 880M captures.
sources.caveat: Bounded diagnostic is not full High B03.
